defs.def: a university teacher of the highest rank 教授

ex.s: Alvaro Luna, a professor of electrical engineering, said that the system is innovative in so far as it allows for recycled energy to be redirected to specific local uses — in this case powering electric cars parked nearby.
ex.t: 电气工程教授Alvaro Luna表示，该系统的创新之处在于它能让回收的能量转向特定的本地用途——在这里就是为停在附近的电动汽车供电。

ex.s: Now, Pereira has teamed up with plant scientist Professor Wolfgang Busch to apply SLEAP to plants.
ex.t: 现在，佩雷拉与植物学家沃尔夫冈·布施教授合作，将SLEAP应用于植物研究。

ex.s: Once in a lecture, the professor tried repeating my name after me over and over in front of thirty classmates.
ex.t: 有一次在课上，教授当着三十名同学的面，一遍又一遍地跟着我重复我的名字。

ex.s: According to Charlotte Markey, a professor of psychology, food is one of the rare subjects where, as parents, saying less is more.
ex.t: 据心理学教授Charlotte Markey所说，食物是少数几个话题之一，在这些话题上，作为父母，少说比多说更好。

ex.s: “With the rise of technology it is easy for people to make observations of different species with the aid of a mobile application,” said Barnabas Daru, who is lead author of the study and assistant professor of biology in the Stanford School of Humanities and Sciences.

ex.s: 37   We interviewed students and professors to get their advice about online courses.
ex.t: 37   我们采访了学生和教授，听取他们对在线课程的建议。

ex.s: You can also find students on the class discussion board to organize a study group, or schedule in-person meetings with your professor to discuss course concepts.
ex.t: 你也可以在课堂讨论板上找同学组建学习小组，或约教授当面讨论课程概念。

ex.s: Professor Alex Davidson teaches the same course in person and online.
ex.t: 亚历克斯·戴维森教授亲自和在线教授同一门课程。

ex.s: I guess I was better than the others, for Miss Chevalier asked a while later, “Addie, I was wondering if you would recite the whole poem to the Saturday evening’s club.” She said a famous professor was going to give a lecture about the poet, and a presentation of that poem would be a fresh way to start.
ex.t: 我想我比其他人强一些，因为谢瓦利埃小姐过了一会儿问道："艾迪，我在想你是否愿意在周六晚上的读书会上把整首诗背诵出来。"她说一位著名教授将要做一个关于这位诗人的讲座，而朗诵那首诗会是一个新颖的开场方式。

ex.s: So I was shocked when, not long after the email, Professor Mary Devon, who was running the programme, invited me to observe the work being done in her lab.
ex.t: 所以，在那封邮件之后不久，负责该项目的玛丽·德文教授邀请我去观察她的实验室工作时，我感到非常震惊。

ex.s: I found myself working with a robotics professor on techniques for collecting data from the desert remotely.
ex.t: 我发现自己正与一位机器人学教授合作，研究从沙漠远程收集数据的技术。

ex.s: Where is Professor Bastian's book about?
ex.t: 巴斯蒂安教授的书是关于哪里的？

ex.t: 巴斯蒂安教授接下来打算做什么？

ex.s: “What would the world be if there were no hunger?” It’s a question that Professor Crystal would ask her students.
ex.t: "如果没有饥饿，世界会是什么样？"这是Crystal教授会问她学生的问题。

ex.s: An Australian professor is developing a robot to monitor the health of grazing cattle, a development that could bring big changes to a profession that's relied largely on a low-tech approach for decades but is facing a labor shortage.
ex.t: 一位澳大利亚教授正在开发一种机器人，用于监测放牧牛群的健康，这一进展可能给一个几十年来主要依赖低技术手段、正面临劳动力短缺的行业带来巨大变化。

ex.s: These include plants that have sensors printed onto their leaves to show when they’re short of water and a plant that can detect harmful chemicals in groundwater. ＂We’re thinking about how we can engineer plants to replace functions of the things that we use every day,＂explained Michael Strano, a professor of chemical engineering at MIT.
ex.t: 这些包括叶子上印有传感器、能显示植物何时缺水的植物，以及一种能检测地下水中有害化学物质的植物。“我们正在思考如何改造植物，以取代我们日常使用物品的功能，”麻省理工学院化学工程教授Michael Strano解释道。

ex.s: What is special about the BYU professors’ study?
ex.t: BYU教授的研究有什么特别之处？

ex.s: Mitch Prinstein, a professor of clinical psychology sorts the popular into two categories: the likable and the status seekers.
ex.t: 临床心理学教授米奇·普林斯坦将受欢迎的人分为两类：讨人喜欢的和追求地位的人。

ex.s: In a 2014 study, Elizabeth Dunn, associate professor of psychology at UBC, invited people on their way into a coffee shop.
ex.t: 在2014年一项研究中，UBC心理学副教授伊丽莎白·邓恩邀请了正走进咖啡店的人。

ex.s: The man thinks Professor Smith explained the physics problem very clearly.

ex.t: 在菲尔·布莱斯教授的领导下，纽卡斯尔团队正在为老年驾驶员开发车载技术，他们希望这些技术能帮助他们在晚年继续驾驶。

ex.s: When your boss or professor sends you out to do man-on-the-street interviews for a story, think about the topic and develop a list of about ten general questions relating to it.
ex.t: 当你的老板或教授派你出去为一篇报道做街头采访时，先想想主题，并就此列出大约十个相关问题。

ex.s: It’s written by Professor Lee.
ex.t: 这是李教授写的。

ex.s: Tolkien (1892-1973) was an English writer, poet and university professor, best known as the author of some of the world’s most popular high-fantasy novels.
ex.t: 托尔金（1892-1973）是一位英国作家、诗人和大学教授，最以创作了全球最受欢迎的一些高阶奇幻小说而闻名。

ex.s: Biologist Professor Pierre Aronnax and his servant, Conseil, join a ship to find and kill the Creature.
ex.t: 生物学家皮埃尔\u00b7阿龙纳斯教授和他的仆人康塞尔，登上一艘船去寻找并杀死那个怪物。

ex.s: He attended night school at Columbia University, where his professor recognised his talent as a writer and helped him get some of his stories published.
ex.t: 尽管\/虽然他的故事可能没有明确的结局，但他自己找到了一个感人的结尾。

ex.s: As Kristian Hammond, professor of electrical engineering and computer science at Northwestern University, put it: “There’s never a stage at which the system knows what it’s talking about.”
ex.t: 正如西北大学电气工程与计算机科学教授克里斯蒂安·哈蒙德所言：系统从来没有一个阶段知道自己到底在说什么。

ex.s: “People from cultures that value relationships more than ours does are shocked by the thought of eating alone in front of a computer”, says Art Markman, a professor of psychology at the University of Texas, Austin.
ex.t: "来自比我们更重视人际关系的文化背景的人会对在电脑前独自吃饭的想法感到震惊，"德克萨斯大学奥斯汀分校心理学教授Art Markman说。

ex.s: Salah Sukkarieh, a professor at the University of Sydney, sees robots as necessary given how cattlemen are aging.
ex.t: 悉尼大学教授萨拉赫·苏卡里赫认为，鉴于牧场主日益老龄化，机器人是必要的。

ex.s: It’s this strange form that makes race walking such an attractive activity, however, says Jaclyn Norberg, an assistant professor of exercise science at Salem State University in Salem, Mass.
ex.t: 然而，位于马萨诸塞州塞勒姆的塞勒姆州立大学运动科学助理教授Jaclyn Norberg说，正是这种奇特的形式使竞走成为一项如此有吸引力的运动。

ex.s: Future 3D food printers could make processed food healthier． Hod Lipson， a professor at Columbia University， said， "Food printing could allow consumer to print food with customized nutritional content， like vitamins． So instead of eating a piece of yesterday 's bread from the supermarket， you'd eat something baked just for you on demand．"
ex.t: 未来的3D食品打印机可以让加工食品更健康。哥伦比亚大学教授霍德·利普森说：“食品打印可以让消费者打印出具有定制营养含量的食物，比如维生素。所以，你不必吃超市里昨天烤的面包，而是可以随时吃到专门为你现烤的食物。”

ex.s: “I didn’t like the ending,” I said to my favorite college professor.
ex.t: "我不喜欢这个结局，"我对我最喜欢的大学教授说。
